value.rationale: The naturally distinguished alternating binary words are a benchmark for the fixed small-alphabet scattered-palindrome enumeration problem left open in Mahalingam–Pandoh 2021. The result gives the full length distribution and infinitely many exact totals rather than extending a short finite table, with a derived logarithmic growth law contrasting palindromes and all subsequences. It does not assert binary extremality.
